name: docx-template-fill
description: Fill Word document (.docx) templates that use placeholder syntax like {{PLACEHOLDER}}. Handles split placeholders (where Word splits a placeholder across multiple XML runs), conditional sections ({{IF_X}}...{{END_IF_X}}), and preserves formatting. Use this skill whenever the user asks to fill a Word template, generate a document from a template, or replace placeholders in a .docx file.
